strategy.thesis: 'Day Zero' company-builder that invests before founders have a team or product. Runs a residency that matches co-founders, validates ideas and then invests in the resulting startups, supporting the creation of companies from scratch.

summary.en: Founded in Singapore in 2017 by Magnus Grimeland (ex-Zalora/Rocket Internet) and Fridtjof Berge. Antler's 'Day Zero' model co-builds companies by matching co-founders, validating ideas and investing at the earliest stage; its first Singapore cohort (2018) accepted 62 of 1,400 applicants, producing 13 companies. Now operates in 30+ cities globally.
